109:6.text: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."

2:37.text: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

2:112.text: Yes [on the contrary], whoever submits his face in Islam to Allah while being a doer of good will have his reward with his Lord. And no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.

2:128.text: Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

2:172.text: O you who have believed, eat from the good things which We have provided for you and be grateful to Allah if it is [indeed] Him that you worship.

2:195.text: And spend in the way of Allah and do not throw [yourselves] with your [own] hands into destruction [by refraining]. And do good; indeed, Allah loves the doers of good.

2:263.text: Kind speech and forgiveness are better than charity followed by injury. And Allah is Free of need and Forbearing.

2:268.text: Satan threatens you with poverty and orders you to immorality, while Allah promises you forgiveness from Him and bounty. And Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

2:274.text: Those who spend their wealth [in Allah 's way] by night and by day, secretly and publicly - they will have their reward with their Lord. And no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.

3:16.text: Those who say, "Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire,"

3:18.text: Allah witnesses that there is no deity except Him, and [so do] the angels and those of knowledge - [that He is] maintaining [creation] in justice. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

3:38.text: At that, Zechariah called upon his Lord, saying, "My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication."

3:92.text: Never will you attain the good [reward] until you spend [in the way of Allah] from that which you love. And whatever you spend - indeed, Allah is Knowing of it.

3:134.text: Who spend [in the cause of Allah] during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allah loves the doers of good;

3:135.text: And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves [by transgression], remember Allah and seek forgiveness for their sins - and who can forgive sins except Allah? - and [who] do not persist in what they have done while they know.

3:150.text: But Allah is your protector, and He is the best of helpers.

4:40.text: Indeed, Allah does not do injustice, [even] as much as an atom's weight; while if there is a good deed, He multiplies it and gives from Himself a great reward.

4:86.text: And when you are greeted with a greeting, greet [in return] with one better than it or [at least] return it [in a like manner]. Indeed, Allah is ever, over all things, an Accountant.

4:110.text: And whoever does a wrong or wrongs himself but then seeks forgiveness of Allah will find Allah Forgiving and Merciful.

4:124.text: And whoever does righteous deeds, whether male or female, while being a believer - those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged, [even as much as] the speck on a date seed.

5:100.text: Say, "Not equal are the evil and the good, although the abundance of evil might impress you." So fear Allah, O you of understanding, that you may be successful.

6:17.text: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him. And if He touches you with good - then He is over all things competent.

6:32.text: And the worldly life is not but amusement and diversion; but the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allah, so will you not reason?

6:79.text: Indeed, I have turned my face toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allah."

6:96.text: [He is] the cleaver of daybreak and has made the night for rest and the sun and moon for calculation. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

6:102.text: That is Allah, your Lord; there is no deity except Him, the Creator of all things, so worship Him. And He is Disposer of all things.

6:160.text: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have ten times the like thereof [to his credit], and whoever comes with an evil deed will not be recompensed except the like thereof; and they will not be wronged.

7:55.text: Call upon your Lord in humility and privately; indeed, He does not like transgressors.

7:56.text: And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good.

7:126.text: And you do not resent us except because we believed in the signs of our Lord when they came to us. Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You]."

7:151.text: [Moses] said, "My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful."

7:205.text: And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless.

9:128.text: There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves. Grievous to him is what you suffer; [he is] concerned over you and to the believers is kind and merciful.

10:5.text: It is He who made the sun a shining light and the moon a derived light and determined for it phases - that you may know the number of years and account [of time]. Allah has not created this except in truth. He details the signs for a people who know

10:25.text: And Allah invites to the Home of Peace and guides whom He wills to a straight path

10:44.text: Indeed, Allah does not wrong the people at all, but it is the people who are wronging themselves.

10:58.text: Say, "In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate."

10:85.text: So they said, "Upon Allah do we rely. Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people

10:86.text: And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people."

11:6.text: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage. All is in a clear register.

11:56.text: Indeed, I have relied upon Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but that He holds its forelock. Indeed, my Lord is on a path [that is] straight."

11:112.text: So remain on a right course as you have been commanded, [you] and those who have turned back with you [to Allah], and do not transgress. Indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.

11:115.text: And be patient, for indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.

12:92.text: He said, "No blame will there be upon you today. Allah will forgive you; and He is the most merciful of the merciful."

12:101.text: My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous."

14:24.text: Have you not considered how Allah presents an example, [making] a good word like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed and its branches [high] in the sky?

14:25.text: It produces its fruit all the time, by permission of its Lord. And Allah presents examples for the people that perhaps they will be reminded.

14:39.text: Praise to Allah, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.

14:40.text: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

14:41.text: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established."

15:49.text: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.

15:98.text: So exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].

15:99.text: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).

16:53.text: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allah. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.

16:78.text: And Allah has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and intellect that perhaps you would be grateful.

16:96.text: Whatever you have will end, but what Allah has is lasting. And We will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do.

17:29.text: And do not make your hand [as] chained to your neck or extend it completely and [thereby] become blamed and insolvent.

17:35.text: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even balance. That is the best [way] and best in result.

17:53.text: And tell My servants to say that which is best. Indeed, Satan induces [dissension] among them. Indeed Satan is ever, to mankind, a clear enemy.

17:84.text: Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."

18:23.text: And never say of anything, "Indeed, I will do that tomorrow,"

18:24.text: Except [when adding], "If Allah wills." And remember your Lord when you forget [it] and say, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to what is nearer than this to right conduct."

18:110.text: Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."

19:65.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"

19:93.text: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.

20:2.text: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed

20:3.text: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah] -

20:8.text: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.

20:14.text: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.

20:55.text: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.

20:82.text: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.

20:132.text: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.

21:30.text: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?

21:33.text: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.

21:35.text: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.

21:69.text: Allah said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."

21:83.text: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful."

21:84.text: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allah].

21:89.text: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors."

22:77.text: O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good - that you may succeed.

23:97.text: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,

23:98.text: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."

23:118.text: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."

25:47.text: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.

25:58.text: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allah] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted -

25:71.text: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance.

25:74.text: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."

26:87.text: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

26:88.text: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children

26:89.text: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."

26:217.text: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

26:218.text: Who sees you when you arise

26:219.text: And your movement among those who prostrate.

26:220.text: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

27:19.text: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."

28:16.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me," and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

28:24.text: So he watered [their flocks] for them; then he went back to the shade and said, "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need."

28:60.text: And whatever thing you [people] have been given - it is [only for] the enjoyment of worldly life and its adornment. And what is with Allah is better and more lasting; so will you not use reason?

28:83.text: That home of the Hereafter We assign to those who do not desire exaltedness upon the earth or corruption. And the [best] outcome is for the righteous.

29:6.text: And whoever strives only strives for [the benefit of] himself. Indeed, Allah is free from need of the worlds.

29:57.text: Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned.

29:60.text: And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. Allah provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

30:17.text: So exalted is Allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.

30:18.text: And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.

30:23.text: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.

30:50.text: So observe the effects of the mercy of Allah - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.

30:60.text: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].

31:12.text: And We had certainly given Luqman wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allah." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

31:14.text: And We have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. His mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents; to Me is the [final] destination.

31:16.text: [And Luqman said], "O my son, indeed if wrong should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Indeed, Allah is Subtle and Acquainted.

31:22.text: And whoever submits his face to Allah while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allah will be the outcome of [all] matters.

31:27.text: And if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea [was ink], replenished thereafter by seven [more] seas, the words of Allah would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise.

33:3.text: And rely upon Allah; and sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.

35:2.text: Whatever Allah grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds - none can release it thereafter. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

35:34.text: And they will say, "Praise to Allah, who has removed from us [all] sorrow. Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative -

36:36.text: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.

37:99.text: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.

37:100.text: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

37:180.text: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.

37:182.text: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

39:42.text: Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

39:46.text: Say, "O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."

39:62.text: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.

40:44.text: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed, Allah is Seeing of [His] servants."

40:61.text: It is Allah who made for you the night that you may rest therein and the day giving sight. Indeed, Allah is full of bounty to the people, but most of the people are not grateful.

41:46.text: Whoever does righteousness - it is for his [own] soul; and whoever does evil [does so] against it. And your Lord is not ever unjust to [His] servants.

41:53.text: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth. But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness?

42:25.text: And it is He who accepts repentance from his servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.

42:28.text: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.

42:43.text: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [requiring] determination.

43:13.text: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say. "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.

43:14.text: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."

51:17.text: They used to sleep but little of the night,

51:18.text: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

51:19.text: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

51:20.text: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

51:21.text: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

51:50.text: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

52:48.text: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.

54:49.text: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.

55:78.text: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

57:3.text: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.

59:10.text: And [there is a share for] those who came after them, saying, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful."

59:21.text: If We had sent down this Qur'an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and coming apart from fear of Allah. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought.

61:2.text: O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?

61:3.text: Great is hatred in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do.

63:9.text: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from remembrance of Allah. And whoever does that - then those are the losers.

64:13.text: Allah - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allah let the believers rely.

64:17.text: If you loan Allah a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allah is Most Appreciative and Forbearing.

66:11.text: And Allah presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."

67:13.text: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

67:14.text: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?

67:15.text: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

67:19.text: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.

67:23.text: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."

67:29.text: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."

68:4.text: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.

70:21.text: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],

73:9.text: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.

75:22.text: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,

76:8.text: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,

78:6.text: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

78:8.text: And We created you in pairs

78:9.text: And made your sleep [a means for] rest

80:24.text: Then let mankind look at his food -

80:25.text: How We poured down water in torrents,

80:26.text: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],

80:27.text: And caused to grow within it grain

82:6.text: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,

82:7.text: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

82:8.text: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

85:14.text: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,

87:16.text: But you prefer the worldly life,

87:17.text: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

88:17.text: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?

88:18.text: And at the sky - how it is raised?

88:19.text: And at the mountains - how they are erected?

88:20.text: And at the earth - how it is spread out?

90:8.text: Have We not made for him two eyes?

90:9.text: And a tongue and two lips?

90:10.text: And have shown him the two ways?

92:5.text: As for he who gives and fears Allah

92:7.text: We will ease him toward ease.

92:18.text: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

92:19.text: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded

92:20.text: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.

92:21.text: And he is going to be satisfied.

93:6.text: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?

93:7.text: And He found you lost and guided [you],

93:8.text: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.

93:9.text: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].

93:10.text: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].

93:11.text: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].

94:7.text: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].

94:8.text: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.

106:1.text: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -

106:2.text: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -

106:3.text: Let them worship the Lord of this House,

106:4.text: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
